rows.name: Florida Water Quality API — public water systems
rows.limitations: Normalized from EPA SDWIS and UCMR 5. Inventory and service areas are self-reported by utilities and lag by a reporting cycle. ZIP codes are mail routes, not service-area boundaries.
rows.verification: Confirm against your utility's own Consumer Confidence Report.

rows.name: Contaminant limit reference (MCL / MCLG / action levels)
rows.limitations: Maintained snapshot of federal drinking-water limits, not a live feed from the CFR. PFAS limits in particular remain subject to reconsideration.
rows.verification: Re-verify against 40 CFR 141 before any compliance use.
